page.overview:
Who is Elrood II?

Emperor Elrood II, also known by the nickname "Elrood Menemtahe", was the twelfth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 207–236 AG). He was a grandson of the third emperor, Corrin I Palaigo, and overthrew his predecessor, Estil I.

Elrood II was a cousin of Emperor Elrood I al-Aziz (r. 73–104 AG), and thus a grandson of Emperor Corrin I Palaigo (r. 14–12 BG). He belonged to the House of Saluso Corrino, which had been supplanted on the Golden Lion Throne by the rival House of Alman Corrino in 184 AG.

In 207 AG, Elrood II was restored to the throne with the aid of Thomas Atreides, deposing the Alman Corrino emperor Estil I. Elrood rewarded Atreides by granting him the Dukedom of Jaddua and a planetary fiefdom. Elrood ruled until 236 AG, when he was succeeded by his cousin Rugo I Saluso II.
